note: Known conformance failures as of 2026-10-22. The harness exits 1 on a FAIL not listed here and on a listed entry that now passes, so this list only shrinks. Reasons are one line each; fixes belong to the v2 verifier rows, not to this one.

entries.reason: art-424 derives the key id with Ed25519 note byte 0x01 and signs cosignature/v1 over a bare timestamp line; the sigsum-go vector's key id does not match (keyid_match=false) and C2SP tlog-cosignature signs a 'time N' line before the checkpoint body
art-287 requires an integer statusListIndex and base64url without multibase 'u' or GZIP; the REC example list is a string index over multibase-u GZIP
art-287 has no statusPurpose check; it fails earlier on the string statusListIndex and never compares entry and list purposes
art-287 caps the decoded list at 8192 bytes and cannot decode multibase-u GZIP, so a REC-minimum 16KB list is not accepted
